name: MOROS
description: Moros runs the Granophyre. The pack is one channel captured three ways: the head on its own, with an Idiot Box Blower Box in front, and with a Plumes (mode 2) in front. The old VOICE switch is now a BOOST button that steps through those (BB = Blower Box, PL = Plumes), the HIGH/LOW and ACTIVE switches are gone, and the blue lamp is the power switch.
